newsitem.title: USA: Northern States unit in preferred filing.
newsitem.headline: Northern States unit in preferred filing.

text.p: Northern States Power Co on Friday said its NSP Financing I subsidiary filed a shelf registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $200 million in preferred shares.
The trust-originated preferred securities will have a liquidation amount of $25 each, according to the filing.
Merrill Lynch & Co, A.G. Edwards & Sons Inc, Goldman Sachs & Co, Bear Stearns & Co Inc, Dain Bosworth Inc, Dean Witter Reynolds Inc and Piper Jaffray Inc will manage the offering.
Proceeds will be invested by the trust in junior subordinated debentures. The balance will be used by the company for general corporate purposes including repayment of short-term borrowings.

Northern States Power Co, based in Minneapolis, is predominately engaged in the generation, transmission and distribution of electricity throughout a 49,000-square-mile service area. It also transports and distributes natural gas in about 156 communities within the area.
